summary: Training reference for the Revibe Warranty - Wrong Device workflow (Seller and KAM audience). The source is a single PDF page (no narration), a 4-step end-to-end flow plus a dispute-resolution branch. Warranty period is not checked: the claim goes straight to the original seller or repair partner. The seller's two decisions are marking the claim VALID (replacement or refund) or INVALID (proof and Lab verification).

steps.screen: Revibe Warranty - Wrong Device overview, card 1 'Customer raise claim'
steps.action: Customer raises a wrong-device claim through the 'My Account' section on Revibe. Claim status is Pending (Revibe team to review). Label: NO ACTION REQUIRED.

evidence.quote: The customer raises a wrong-device claim through the “My Account” section on Revibe. Status: Pending (Revibe team to review). NO ACTION REQUIRED

steps.action: Revibe agent reviews the customer's proof. If docs are missing, they are requested; if not provided, the claim is Cancelled. Once validated, the request moves on. Status: Pending Collection. Label: NO ACTION REQUIRED.

evidence.quote: The agent reviews the customer's proof (missing docs → requested; not provided → Cancelled). Once validated the request moves on. Status: Pending Collection

steps.action: Pickup depends on the courier. AE and Others: AWB is auto-created (AE = Quiqup, Others = DHL) and the claim moves to Under Collection immediately. SA: the seller creates the AWB manually. Repair partner: always automatic (SA = Naqel). Label: ACTION REQUIRED IF SA.

evidence.quote: AE & Others: AWB auto-created (AE = Quiqup · Others = DHL) — moves to Under Collection immediately. SA: Seller to create the AWB manually. Repair partner: always auto (SA = Naqel)

steps.action: After the Courier Company delivers to the seller, the seller can see the claim, which status becomes Under QC. The seller marks the claim VALID or INVALID. Label: ACTION REQUIRED.

evidence.quote: Once the Courier Company delivers the seller can see the claim which status becomes Under QC. Two options: Mark VALID / Mark INVALID

steps.action: Seller confirms stock of the right device. If available, the correct device is shipped to the customer. If not available, an automated refund is charged to the seller at actual cost and the case is closed.

evidence.quote: Seller confirms stock of the right device. Available → correct device shipped to the customer. Not available → automated refund, charged to the seller (actual cost). Case closed.

steps.screen: Overview, box 'INVALID - Proof Required -> Revibe Review -> Lab Verification', column 'Seller submits proof'
steps.action: Seller submits proof: a written reason plus supporting proof to challenge the customer claim.

evidence.quote: Seller submits proof. Required: written reason + supporting proof to challenge the customer claim.

steps.action: Revibe checks the proof. Good proof: device sent to Lab. Proof rejected: claim re-marked Valid, then replacement or refund. Repair partner: no Lab, Revibe decides.

evidence.quote: Good proof → device sent to Lab. Proof rejected → re-marked Valid → replacement or refund. Repair partner: no Lab, Revibe decides

steps.action: Revibe Lab makes the final decision. Valid: full refund and ship back to seller. Invalid: customer pays = ship to customer; customer does not pay = device disposed.

evidence.quote: Valid → full refund + ship back to seller. Invalid → customer pays = ship to customer; doesn't pay = device disposed

steps.action: If delivery fails on ship-back, the agent offers a new AWB. If refused, the device is sent to disposal. All refunds, credits and charges appear in the payment tool.

evidence.quote: Delivery failed on ship-back: agent offers a new AWB · refused → device sent to disposal. Payment: all refunds, credits and charges appear in the payment tool.

screens.name: Revibe Warranty - Wrong Device workflow overview
screens.shows: Four numbered cards (1 Customer raise claim, 2 Revibe Agent Check, 3 Pickup, 4 Seller action) with action labels, a DISPUTE RESOLUTION section with VALID and INVALID branches, and a footer with ship-back failure and payment notes.

screens.name: Status labels in the flow
screens.shows: Status lines read 'Status: Pending' (card 1) and 'Status: Pending Collection' (card 2). 'Under Collection' (card 3) and 'Under QC' (card 4) appear as bold text in the card bodies, not as badges. Decision buttons: Mark VALID (green) and Mark INVALID (red).
